Now that I think of it, Melissa really became a part of our group. We hang out pretty much every few days.
She was very secretive at first, but after hanging out with us for so long, I think I understand her a little better.
The thing about her co-worker and his girlfriend…{{wi}} It’s very unfortunate that it happened, but we can’t turn back time. I just wish that she has a little more peace of mind because of us.
I think that’s the place she sent me the address for.
Is that…{{wi}} some private clinic?
Why would she invite me here? She’s a bot so she can’t possibly be injured, right?
I guess there’s only one way to find out…
